title: Lavender Reception
description: One colour carried the length of the room. A lavender cheesecloth runner falls off the edge of a long guest table over a silver sequin underlay, with clear chargers, mercury-glass candles, and low posies at each cover. The same lavender returns on the welcome table — a name-tag sign, a framed seating card, a pillar candle — and again on the favour table, where rolled takeaways sit beside a honeymoon-fund frame.
